newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Oil shuts Mizushima topper for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Oil shuts Mizushima topper for maintenance.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it closed its 130,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Mizushima plant, western Japan, on Sunday for routine maintenance.
The topper is scheduled to resume operations on June 21, a Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said.
Other major secondary refining facilities to be closed for maintenance checks are as follows:
Catalytic cracker 11,000 end-May to early July
Major refining facilities at the Mizushima plant which will skip maintenance work this year are as follows: CDU 100,000
Mitsubishi Oil's 75,000 bpd topper at the Kawasaki refinery, near Tokyo, is due to close in September for routine maintenance work.
